data.name: Bibek
data.gender_notes: Bibek is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bibhak', meaning 'to discriminate'. Bibek is a name of great wisdom and intelligence, signifying the ability to discern truth from falsehood and make wise decisions. This name is deeply rooted in the Hindu tradition and is considered a symbol of knowledge and understanding. The name Bibek carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Thoughtful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bibek usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, thoughtful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a name of respect and is often given to children who show great potential in academics or those who demonstrate the ability to make intelligent decisions from a young age.
